verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes Honeycomb as a hosted service: data is sent to Honeycomb via OTLP, and users choose between EU and North America account regions. Nothing documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. Region choice and OpenTelemetry ingestion are adjacent features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
